Its optional FMA feature prepends itself with fma.pNext=create_info.pNext; absent-FMA path preserves existing node. Portability subset extension and failure behavior unchanged.
findings.determinism_cache_identity: Repeated helper reads only immutable physical properties/feature support and DeviceInfo fields not changed by FMA admission. Exact kernel words and physical device fix policy for device lifetime, so existing pipeline key remains sufficient without class/state/ABI changes.
findings.selector: Full-length full-word span equality with generated ordinary nativeFP32 kTransportShader only. Narrow/wide/FMA/portable/owner/other stages have different words and retain null stagepNext. No substring/name/hash-only dispatch selector.
findings.pipeline: Only selected pipeline receives requiredSubgroupSize32; original entrymain, descriptor/layout, local64x1x1 shader, float modes, barriers/status, input/output/40fields, cancellation/refusal cleanup and pipeline failure handling stay unchanged. computeFullSubgroups remainsfalse and no full-subgroup flag is introduced.
findings.optional_modes: No-retained branch restored by compile guards; nonAMD/software/portable/API<1.3/missing feature/properties use original creation/pipeline policy. Header/class/publicABI/shader/layout/cache/governors unchanged.
findings.controls: Other shader source selection is unchanged, not an assertion that all control results are already proved. New same-provider raw-word/control8 and all eight original controls plus sole original22-gate benefit remain mandatory before adoption.

driver_premise.claim: Diagnostic codegen/resource observations only; no dynamic occupancy, timing, benefit or correctness inference.

limits: No new compilation or runtime admission granted by this source review.
Enabling optional subgroup feature does not alter other source stage settings; actual driver output/numeric equality and original benefit gates remain empirical obligations.
Supported feature requests may still fail at Vulkan device/pipeline creation; original explicit error paths remain, no silent fallback or changed numerical policy.
